decisions.finding: Beneath the initial Vav of ויֵּצֵא, high-resolution zoom 6 capture reveals a crisp, solid horizontal Patah bar spanning 46 pixels wide and 23 pixels high (rows 259..281) directly below the Vav stem, followed by clean white paper below. Distinct from Sheva; matches positive control Patah. Confirmed printed Patah (U+05B7).

Beneath the initial Vav of ויִּשְׂרֹף, 36 consecutive vertical rows (y=249..284) across the entire width of the Vav stem are 100% clean white paper with zero ink (mean brightness 251.7). The consonant is printed unpointed without a vowel mark. Confirmed unpointed consonant for initial Vav.
